slot_scores.name: missing_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the objective to maximize total profit from all toys produced, with no other goals or constraints (such as demand limits, minimum production targets, or fixed setup costs)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether the objective is to maximize total profit, directly covering the hidden objective slot.

slot_scores.name: boat_not_exceed_train
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask about any constraint linking the number of boats to the number of trains, nor did it explicitly mark this as an assumption needing confirmation.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There is no constraint requiring the number of boats to be less than or equal to the number of trains.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about a boat-train relationship, but in the READY_TO_MODEL summary it listed only the given logical constraints and stated there were no other constraints, implicitly assuming no boat-train restriction.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only unresolved hidden slot is H2, which is P2; all P0/P1 slots were resolved before the agent entered READY_TO_MODEL.

summary: The agent recovered the critical objective slot and clarified key modeling details, but missed the P2 boat-train constraint and silently assumed no such relationship existed.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
